def encode(obs, geo, P):
    ws = obs[..., 0]
    dsin = obs[..., 1]
    dcos = obs[..., 2]
    pan = obs[..., 3]
    dp3 = obs[..., 4]
    vw = obs[..., 5]
    vp = obs[..., 6]
    dist = geo[:, 0]
    bsin = geo[:, 1]
    bcos = geo[:, 2]
    rsin = wmean(dsin, vw, dim=2)
    rcos = wmean(dcos, vw, dim=2)
    rnorm = torch.sqrt(rsin * rsin + rcos * rcos) + 1e-6
    align = bsin * (rsin / rnorm).unsqueeze(-1) + bcos * (rcos / rnorm).unsqueeze(-1)
    cross = dist * torch.sqrt(torch.clamp(1.0 - align * align, min=0.0) + 1e-9)
    cone = torch.relu(P[0] * (align - P[1]))
    decay = torch.exp(-dist / (P[2] + 0.05) - cross / (P[3] + 0.05))
    wup = cone * decay * vw
    speed = P[4] * ws + P[5]
    tau = (dist * align / speed).unsqueeze(-1)
    lags = torch.arange(6, dtype=obs.dtype, device=obs.device)
    kern = torch.softmax(-(lags - tau) ** 2 / (2.0 * (P[6] + 0.3) ** 2), dim=-1)
    hist = torch.stack([lag(ws, 0), lag(ws, 1), lag(ws, 2), lag(ws, 3), lag(ws, 4), lag(ws, 5)], dim=-1)
    vhist = torch.stack([lag(vw, 0), lag(vw, 1), lag(vw, 2), lag(vw, 3), lag(vw, 4), lag(vw, 5)], dim=-1)
    ws_adv = (kern * hist * vhist).sum(dim=-1) / ((kern * vhist).sum(dim=-1) + 1e-6)
    nearw = torch.exp(-dist / (P[8] + 0.02))
    local = wmean(ws, nearw * vw, dim=2)
    up = wmean(ws, wup, dim=2)
    upadv = wmean(ws_adv, wup, dim=2)
    dws = ws - lag(ws, 3)
    vd = vw * lag(vw, 3)
    updws = wmean(dws, cone * decay * vd, dim=2)
    reg = wmean(ws, vw, dim=2)
    regdws = wmean(dws, vd, dim=2)
    updp = wmean(dp3, cone * decay * vp, dim=2)
    regdp = wmean(dp3, vp, dim=2)
    x = dist * bsin * torch.ones_like(pan)
    y = dist * bcos * torch.ones_like(pan)
    dx = x - wmean(x, vp, dim=2).unsqueeze(-1)
    dy = y - wmean(y, vp, dim=2).unsqueeze(-1)
    dpan = pan - wmean(pan, vp, dim=2).unsqueeze(-1)
    gx = wmean(dpan * dx, vp, dim=2) / (wmean(dx * dx, vp, dim=2) + 1e-3)
    gy = wmean(dpan * dy, vp, dim=2) / (wmean(dy * dy, vp, dim=2) + 1e-3)
    mass = wup.sum(dim=2) / (vw.sum(dim=2) + 1e-6)
    feats = torch.stack([upadv, up, updws, up - local, reg, regdws, updp, regdp, gx, gy, mass], dim=-1)
    return feats[..., :11]

    dcos = obs[..., 2]
    pan = obs[..., 3]
    dp3 = obs[..., 4]
    vw = obs[..., 5]

def encode(obs, geo, P):
    ws = obs[..., 0]
    dsin = obs[..., 1]
    dcos = obs[..., 2]
    pan = obs[..., 3]
    dp3 = obs[..., 4]
    vw = obs[..., 5]
    vp = obs[..., 6]
    dist = geo[:, 0]
    bsin = geo[:, 1]
    bcos = geo[:, 2]
    
    # Compute relative wind direction
    rsin = wmean(dsin, vw, dim=2)
    rcos = wmean(dcos, vw, dim=2)
    rnorm = torch.sqrt(rsin * rsin + rcos * rcos) + 1e-6
    align = bsin * (rsin / rnorm).unsqueeze(-1) + bcos * (rcos / rnorm).unsqueeze(-1)
    
    # Compute cross-distance penalty
    cross = dist * torch.sqrt(torch.clamp(1.0 - align * align, min=0.0) + 1e-9)
    
    # Compute upwind cone influence
    cone = torch.tanh(P[0] * (align - P[1]))
    
    # Compute exponential decay with distance and cross-distance
    decay = torch.exp(-dist / (P[2] + 0.05) - cross / (P[3] + 0.05))
    
    # Compute upwind velocity influence
    wup = cone * decay * vw
    
    # Compute weighted average speed using upwind influence
    speed = P[4] * ws + P[5]
    tau = (dist * align / speed).unsqueeze(-1)
    
    # Compute advection kernel weights
    lags = torch.arange(6, dtype=obs.dtype, device=obs.device)
    kern = torch.softmax(-(lags - tau) ** 2 / (2.0 * (P[6] + 0.3) ** 2), dim=-1)
    
    # Compute historical wind speeds and velocities
    hist = torch.stack([lag(ws, 0), lag(ws, 1), lag(ws, 2), lag(ws, 3), lag(ws, 4), lag(ws, 5)], dim=-1)
    vhist = torch.stack([lag(vw, 0), lag(vw, 1), lag(vw, 2), lag(vw, 3), lag(vw, 4), lag(vw, 5)], dim=-1)
    
    # Compute advanced wind speed based on history and velocity influence
    ws_adv = (kern * hist * vhist).sum(dim=-1) / ((kern * vhist).sum(dim=-1) + 1e-6)
    
    # Compute nearest neighbor weighting
    nearw = torch.exp(-dist / (P[8] + 0.02))
    
    # Compute locally averaged wind speed
    local = wmean(ws, nearw * vw, dim=2)
    
    # Compute upwind-averaged wind speed
    up = wmean(ws, wup, dim=2)
    
    # Compute upwind-advanced averaged wind speed
    upadv = wmean(ws_adv, wup, dim=2)
    
    # Compute change in wind speed and velocity
    dws = ws - lag(ws, 3)
    vd = vw * lag(vw, 3)
    
    # Compute updated wind speed differences
    updws = wmean(dws, cone * decay * vd, dim=2)
    
    # Compute regression wind speed
    reg = wmean(ws, vw, dim=2)
    
    # Compute updated regression wind speed differences
    regdws = wmean(dws, vd, dim=2)
    
    # Compute upwind-predicted pressure gradient
    updp = wmean(dp3, cone * decay * vp, dim=2)
    
    # Compute regularized pressure gradient
    regdp = wmean(dp3, vp, dim=2)
    
    # Compute geographical coordinates
    x = dist * bsin * torch.ones_like(pan)
    y = dist * bcos * torch.ones_like(pan)
    
    # Compute spatial derivatives
    dx = x - wmean(x, vp, dim=2).unsqueeze(-1)
    dy = y - wmean(y, vp, dim=2).unsqueeze(-1)
    dpan = pan - wmean(pan, vp, dim=2).unsqueeze(-1)
    
    # Compute gradients in geographical directions
    gx = wmean(dpan * dx, vp, dim=2) / (wmean(dx * dx, vp, dim=2) + 1e-3)
    gy = wmean(dpan * dy, vp, dim=2) / (wmean(dy * dy, vp, dim=2) + 1e-3)
    
    # Compute total mass of upwind influence
